blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Commission on Human Rights (CHR) on Wednesday said it is investigating alleged human rights violations during protests held in Manila and Muntinlupa City amid the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits. In a statement, the CHR said it had conducted “Quick Response Operations” at the Manila Police District and the Philippine National Police-National Capital Region office at Camp Bagong Diwa in Taguig City following the mass arrest of protesters last Sunday. The commission noted that more than 200 individuals, including several minors, were brought to Camp Bagong Diwa following demonstrations in Muntinlupa […]...
